summary: The registered 19-test surface passes, but the implemented pack is not ready for closeout. Seven P1 defects can change or falsely authorize the scientific terminal: the nuisance design does not implement the frozen estimand, deletion failures are silently omitted, H identifiability is incorrectly coupled to q degeneracy, the registered cubic-correlation gate is absent, H-only terminal routing contradicts the frozen gate order, the runner does not bind the full spec to the executed configuration, and generation publication is not transactional. Three P2 provenance/test defects remain as well.

findings.title: The fitted nuisance is log(total sigma), not the frozen centered log(e_DMzp)
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:232-239 freezes centered_log_e_DMzp as the nuisance.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:392-417 computes both log_error and train_log from data.sigma, which includes the velocity and systematic floors, and labels that column centered_log_e_DMzp.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:110-126 does not retain e_DMzp in PreparedDirectionalCatalogue, so the frozen nuisance cannot be reconstructed downstream.
findings.impact: This changes the reduced and full design matrices, every observed/null score, response gate, coefficient, stability comparison, finite rank, and terminal while the artifacts claim the frozen estimand.
findings.required_fix: Retain the selected raw e_DMzp array, use log(e_DMzp) for this nuisance, bind its bytes into the design receipt, regenerate the full pack, and add a test that independently distinguishes e_DMzp from the floor-inflated sigma.

findings.title: Deletion rank or fit failures are silently skipped and can produce a stability false green
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:331-344 requires all named deletion/depth summaries and routes a deletion-induced response-rank failure to NON_INFORMATIVE_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_DOMINATED.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:680-700 catches DirectionalCosmographyError for every leave-family, leave-cell, and depth-half case and continues without recording a failed case.

htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:781-865 initializes the maximum discrepancy at zero and gates only cases that survived construction; it never recomputes the prospective rank/condition/information gates on deletions.
Executable probe monkeypatched every deletion fit to raise and _deletion_operators returned an empty case list rather than a failed stability result.
findings.impact: A required sensitivity case can become rank deficient or otherwise non-identifiable and disappear from the report; an empty or incomplete deletion set can still pass the terminal gate.
findings.required_fix: Enumerate and receipt every expected present-family, Nside1-cell, and both depth-half case. Treat inability to fit or failure of the selected response gates as an explicit stability failure, not a skip; assert coverage before terminal routing and add rank-failure mutations.

findings.title: H identifiability incorrectly depends on the joint H/q condition number
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:309-312 separates H failure from q failure and requires H-only routing when H passes but q fails.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:543-560 computes one condition number from [h_res,q_cond] and uses it in both h_pass and q_pass.
findings.impact: A nearly singular q block can make the combined condition number fail and incorrectly mark H as unidentifiable even when the three H columns independently have full rank and sufficient information, suppressing the preregistered H-only branch.
findings.required_fix: Compute and report an H-block condition number for h_pass and a separate conditional q/joint condition for q_pass. Add a synthetic test with an identifiable H block and deliberately degenerate q block that must route H_ONLY.

findings.title: The frozen directional-cubic canonical-correlation gate is not implemented
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:305-308 freezes both minimum retained information and max_canonical_correlation=0.95 for the z_squared_times_n stress.

htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:533-560 computes retained_information_q_directional_cubic but only computes/enforces the H/q canonical correlation; no q/cubic stress correlation is computed or compared with 0.95.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:76-85 has no separately bound cubic-correlation threshold.
findings.impact: The q branch may pass although it violates one of the two prospectively frozen cubic-overlap falsifiers.
findings.required_fix: Compute the registered canonical correlation for q versus the residualized directional-cubic block, expose it per fold, enforce its threshold in q_pass, bind the threshold from the spec, and add a near-collinear cubic mutation.

findings.title: H-only terminal routing contradicts the frozen terminal order
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:346-356 routes Q_RESPONSE_FAILURE_WITH_H_PASS to H_ONLY_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL before stability/MC terminals.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:920-948 merely prefixes later stability/MC terminal language for H_ONLY and never emits H_ONLY_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:227-237 excludes the frozen H-only terminal from its allowed set, so a spec-conforming result would be rejected.
Executable probe with branch=H_ONLY, support/stability passing, and guard_interval=[0.10,0.20] returned MATCHED_NULL_CONTAINS_DIRECTIONAL_STATISTIC.
findings.impact: The result card can carry a terminal not authorized for the q-failed branch, and the verifier enforces the implementation's divergent vocabulary rather than the frozen specification.
findings.required_fix: Implement the exact frozen H-only terminal route and retain any H-only rank/stability information as subordinate diagnostics, or prospectively version and re-review the spec before any alternative routing. Add a total terminal truth-table test.

findings.title: The runner hashes the spec but does not bind the executed configuration to it
evidence: scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:92-150 validates only a small subset of scientific fields (notably null_draws and tie_policy).
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:314-325 constructs DirectionalCosmographyConfig from independent code defaults rather than from the frozen spec.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:357-370 copies the spec into the estimand artifact while the analysis may have executed different defaults.
docs/generated/pr179_artifact_manifest.json:57 and 93 record independent config/spec hashes but no equality/crosswalk receipt.
findings.impact: A drift in cuts, floors, nsides, support thresholds, response thresholds, seed, alpha, or other duplicated fields can be re-written into a byte-consistent green pack whose displayed estimand comes from the spec but whose numbers come from different code defaults.
findings.required_fix: Construct the production config from a strict schema-validated spec projection or compare every duplicated field and semantic constant exactly before numerical import. Emit the crosswalk in the manifest and add one mutation per scientific config family.

findings.title: The claimed generation transaction is only a sequence of per-file replaces
evidence: scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:2-7 claims --write atomically publishes one generation.

scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:437-448 fsyncs staged files and then replaces nine live paths one by one, without a lock, journal, generation-directory pointer, rollback/recovery, or destination-directory fsync.
findings.impact: Interruption or concurrent execution can leave a mixed old/new tracked pack; direct artifact consumers can observe that mixed generation before a later --check detects it, and rename durability is not established.
findings.required_fix: Use a repository-standard locked durable journal with deterministic recovery, or publish a complete immutable generation directory and atomically switch one pointer/manifest. Fsync the relevant directories and add interruption/concurrency recovery tests.

findings.title: Column-firewall mutations do not exercise actual production data access
evidence: htt/obsstat/catalogs/cf4_raw.py:81-91 parses any registered label and performs no PR-179 denylist check at the access point.
htt/obsstat/catalogs/cf4_raw.py:234-281 uses direct t3/t4 label calls; require_pr179_columns validates only the separate primary_columns argument.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:217-226 trusts booleans emitted by the same candidate analysis.

scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:272-288 mutates the nominal allowlist or a reported boolean, but never substitutes a forbidden label into a real target/feature/fit/selection/weight/null access path.
docs/generated/pr179_mutation_report.json:62-152 therefore records 18 kills without a production-path forbidden-column mutation.
findings.impact: A future accidental t3('Vpec')/t3('Hi') style production edit can still emit firewall=false and pass the present mutation family; candidate self-attestation is mistaken for independent enforcement.
findings.required_fix: Enforce the denylist at every PR-179 column access or use a capability-limited parsed view, independently inventory runtime/AST accesses, and mutate actual production call sites. Validate expected exception and semantic reason rather than counting any Exception as a kill.

findings.title: The required unsupported-support map is absent
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr179_spec.yaml:288-292 requires every fine support fraction plus an unsupported support map.
htt/obsstat/directional_cosmography.py:251-300 emits aggregate counts, cell-method summaries, and broad-method summaries but no mapping from unsupported stratum tuple to count/rows/hash.
findings.impact: Reviewers cannot audit which frozen fold/sky/broad-family/depth strata were removed from inference, despite the pack claiming the preregistered support diagnostics.
findings.required_fix: Emit a deterministically sorted unsupported-stratum map with the full typed stratum tuple, counts, and stable group-ID hash; bind it into the design/manifest and test reconstruction.

findings.title: Git/worktree and generating-command provenance are hard-coded assertions
evidence: scripts/codex_harness/run_pr179_directional_cosmography.py:198-206 writes a constant command and 'prospective spec commit 652f7c52; PR-179 implementation worktree generation' instead of measuring the producing HEAD and dirty/content state.
docs/generated/pr179_artifact_manifest.json:62-63 repeats those constants.
findings.impact: The required git_commit_or_worktree_state field cannot distinguish producing revisions or unbound dirty changes, and the command string is not an execution receipt.
findings.required_fix: Capture exact HEAD, dirty status, relevant-content hashes, argv/environment, and producer timestamp/receipt at execution; fail closed or disclose untracked/dirty state precisely.

proposed_changes: Correct the frozen nuisance and regenerate every numerical artifact.
Make response and deletion gates total and fail closed, including the H-only and cubic-stress cases.
Bind the full spec projection to executed code configuration and actual column accesses.
Replace sequential publication with a durable recoverable transaction.
Add independent mutation coverage for each reported falsifier and exact support/provenance reconstruction.
tests_to_run: The two registered targeted files after remediation.
Synthetic nuisance test that holds sigma fixed while changing e_DMzp and the converse.
Synthetic H-identifiable/q-degenerate and q/cubic-near-collinear response tests.
Complete deletion coverage tests with rank, condition, and information failures for every case family.
Total terminal truth-table and actual production-access denylist mutations.
Interrupted/concurrent write recovery tests, followed by a fresh full --write/--check replay under the recorded runtime.
risks_and_kill_switches: Do not reuse the current finite rank, coefficients, stability terminal, manifest, or mutation PASS after correcting the nuisance or any response/stability gate; those changes affect the estimand and require complete regeneration.
Do not mark PR-179 complete while any expected deletion case is missing or any spec-to-config field lacks an exact crosswalk.
Do not reinterpret an H-only or selection/systematics-conditional branch as cosmological evidence.
artifacts_status_updates_needed: After remediation, regenerate all nine PR-179 outputs and create a new hash-bound independent code review; do not relabel this verdict.
Keep PR-179 foreground/in-progress and withhold closeout/status promotion until the P1 findings and regenerated evidence pass.
